cues.text: Chauthe patte mein kismat rehti hai.
Aur paanchve patte mein rehta hai...
Ek shaitaan.
Clover Kingdom.
Iss kingdom mein, Magic hi sab kuch hai,

aur Asta kingdom ka akela ladka hai jo
Magic ka istemal nahi kar sakta.

Aur Wizard King ban'ne ke liye, usne khoob
mehnat ki.

Aur ek din, Asta ko anti-magic ki Takat
mili jo Magic ko kaat sakti hai.

Aur usi waqt, Dark Triad jo Spade Kingdom
par raj karte Hai,

unke andar underworld ke shaitaano ki
Takat hai,

aur Woh Dusre desho par Humla shuru karte
Hai.

Ek Darawna ladai ke baad, Asta aur uske
dosto ne
Dark Triad ke Members Dante ko hara diya,

lekin Magic Knights squads ke captains
Yami aur Vangeance

aur Queen Loropechka ko kidnap kar liya
gaya.

Asta ne shaitaan ki asli Takat hasil
karne ki koshish ki
taaki Yami aur baaki sab ko wapas la sake.

Clover Kingdom ka counterattack shuru hone
Waala hai.
Spade Kingdom
Behtar hoga ki mera bhai Theek ho...
Arey Morris.

Diamond Kingdom ke Magic studies mein mera
Head hath tha.

Mai Isey bina kisi Problem ke bilkul theek
kar dunga.

Aur yeh pehle se Jyada taakatwar ban
jayega.
Aur upar se, Woh Magic jo zaruri hai

Qliphoth ritual ke liye, Usey Candelo
ikattha kar raha hai jo maine banaya.
Kaash tu mujh par Jyada Bharoosa karta.

Uss gaddar Mars ki wajah se mujhe kingdom
se nikal diya gaya tha,

lekin mera ant ek aur Jyada dilchasp jagah
par hua.
Shukriya tum sab ka.

Mai Uss chote chhore se dobara ladne ka
intezaar kar raha Hu.

Kya baaki ki taiyariyo mein koi Problem
nahi hai?
Sab kuch theek chal raha hai.
Kya aisa hi Haina Lotus?
Haan.
Lagta hai hum badi musibat mein Hai.
Clover Kingdom
Underworld jahan shaitaan rehte Hai...

Qliphoth ped ke zariye Humari duniya se
juda hai.
Aur Uss ped ko banane ke liye...
Unhe Yami aur Vangeance ki zarurat hai.

3 dino baad, underworld ka gate khul
jayega.

Aur usse pehle, hum Yami aur Vangeance ko
wapas laenge
aur Qliphoth ped ko tabaah kar denge.
Iss baar, hum Humla karenge.

Yakeen nahi hota ki Mai Wizard King hoke
kuch nahi kar paaya Iss waqt.
Tune bilkul sahi chuna.

Lekin iska matlab yeh nahi ki sahi logo ko
Humesha inaam milega.
Ab Humari baari hai!
Isliye tujhe aur taakatwar ban'na hoga,
taaki tu kisi burai ke aage na hare.
Devil Union: Canis.

Ab hum shuru karenge jise tera asli
training kehte Hai.
Tum dono milkar...
Mujhe haraane ki koshish karo!

Asta, sirf wahi rasta hai taakatwar ban'ne
ka

ki Uss shaitaan ke sath union karo aur 100%
anti-magic Takat nikalo.
Poonchh?
Kya? Liebe gayab ho gaya?
Mai yahan hu
Hey- yeh toh bahut chhota ho gaya!

Lagta hai jab Mai apni Takat tujhe deta
Hu

Toh shaitan ke bandhan wale samjhauton
mein,
Control hukm dene wale ke Pass hota hai.
Yaani insaan ke Pass.

Aur isiliye Mai aasani se mel kar pata
Hu.
Teri abhi ki sthiti mel nahi hai.

Uss shaitan ki Takat bas tujh mein tapak
rahi hai.
Tune bhi toh kuch aisa hi kaha tha, Libe!

Mai teri asli Takat kaise istemal
Karu?
Mujhe pata nahi
Kya?!

Mai tera jism hadapne aur ladne ki
koshish kar raha tha.

Yeh pehli baar hai jab Mai bahar aaya aur
lada Hu.

Aur isiliye mujh jaise ko bhi tera hara
diya.

Tu kuch nahi jaanta! Itni badi-badi
Baate karne ke baad bhi!

Tune hi toh mere sath yeh bekaar samjhauta
kiya hai!
Khud hi pata laga le!
Mujhe bhi nahi pata!
Lagta hai...

Tum dono ko ladte waqt iska pata lagana
hoga.
Jab Mai mel ka istemal karta Hu,

Toh Mai apne sabhi shaitano ki
khasiyatein apni parchhai Magic mein jod
sakta Hu.
Gimodelo ki ek khasiyat hai...
Jhund.

In sabhi ke Pass wahi Energy hai jo up-nayak
Nachto ke Pass hai!

Parchhaiyan tab tak gayab nahi hongi jab
tak tu mujhe Sachme hara nahi deta.

Woh iske sath poori tarah mil chuka hai,
isiliye mujhe uska pata nahi chal raha.

Kya iska matlab yeh hai ki up-nayak Nachto
ke 4 shaitano ke sath samjhoute Hai?!

Kya usne in sabhi baar maut ka samna
aamne-Saamne kiya hai?!

Ab jab maine aur Libe ne samjhauta kar
liya hai,

Toh Humara rishta pehle se Jyada mazboot
hona chahiye!

Mujhe uski aur Takat bahar nikalne mein
kabil hona chahiye!

Tune ek shaitan ke sath barabari ka
samjhauta kiya hai.

Kyunki Woh tera naukar nahi hai, isiliye
yeh Aam hai ki tu Uss Takat ka
turant istemal na kar paye.
Tune hi yeh rasta chuna hai.
Uss Takat se mujhe harane ki koshish kar.
Theek hai.

Yahin aur abhi, Mai apni seemayein tod
Dunga.
Shaitan kaatne Waala.

Tera naam hai... Shaitan Kaatne Waala
Katana!

Chalo ek sath chalte hainayak Yami ko
wapas lane!
Yahin aur abhi apni seemayein tod kar!
Mujhe Woh baat pasand nahi hai.

Shukriya mere prashikshan ki dekhbhal
karne ke liye...
Pichhle up-nayak Langris-san.

Tujhe "pichhla" jodne ki Zarurat nahi
thi.

Tu abhi bhi apni aadat se majboor zaalim
hai.
Tere jitna zaalim nahi Hu.

Waise, teri choti si baatuni rooh kahan
hai?

Bell abhi Magic ki kitaab se bahar nahi
aayegi.
Kitni pareshani ki baat hai.

Mujhe yakeen nahi ho raha ki tu rooh ki
Takat ke bina yeh sab kar sakta hai.
Tum dono Phir se haar gaye ho.
Up-nayak Nachto bahut Takatwaar Hai...

Chahe Mai kitni baar bhi chunauti Du,
mujhe jeetne ka koi rasta nahi dikhta.

Phir bhi... shayad Woh Sachme poori Takat
se nahi lad rahe Hai.
Toh yeh hai mel ki Takat...

Kyu... Mai aur Libe wahi cheez nahi kar
sakte?

Halanki jab Mai kaali sthiti mein ghayal
hota Hu, toh Libe bhi ghayal ho jata
hai.
Bahut lazeez hai!

Mere zakhm bhar rahe Hai aur Takat waapas
aa rahi hai!

Woh Magical snacks jo Spade kingdom ke
khilaaf the...
Kya naam tha uska bhala?
Jab milunga Unhe, shukriya ada karunga!
Kuch meetha khane se mujhe ek idea aaya!
Thodi der ke liye mere saath aa, Liebe!

Jab Yeh aisa hota hai, toh 10% maamlon
mein,

uska socha hua idea bilkul genius hota
hai...
Union!

Yeh pakka unhi 90% fail hone wale maamlon
mein se hai.

Humare Pass bakwaas ka waqt nahi hai, 90%
bewakoof!
Mai bakwaas nahi kar raha!

Agar hum aise ladenge, toh Humare dil aur
jism aur jud jayenge aur-

Kya tera itna achha hone ka mann nahi
thakta?

Aur kya tera apni azaadi se dil nahi
bharta, bhai?

Bewakoof. Azaadi mein thakne jaisa kya
hai?
Agar hum Sachme aise jud sakte,
toh koi dikkat hi nahi hoti, 90% bewakoof!

Tune kya kaha?! Tu upar hai, toh faltu
bolna band kar!
Baaki sab se milne ka waqt ho gaya hai.

Do din guzar bhi gaye?! Mujhe pata hi nahi
chala! Sahi mein!

Lagta hai Humare Pass koi aur chara nahi
hai.

Agar yeh kaam nahi kiya, toh yahin mar
jana.
Liebe!
Mana Zone: Dark Prison Hunting Ground.
Yahan har taraf andhera hai...
Yeh...

Mujhe unka ki Mehsus nahi ho raha! Mai
in hamlon se bach nahi paunga!

Tune thodi kaabiliyat dikhayi, isliye yeh
afsosnak hai.

Aisa andhera jisme kuch Mehsus na ho aur
maut kareeb aa rahi ho...
Yahin asli darr hai!
Sahi mein!
Hum itne ghire hue Hai, toh phir Kyu...

Hume aur Takat chahiye... mere aur Asta
ke Ray milne chahiyein!
Phir bhi... hum jud Kyu nahi pa rahe?!
Captain Yami ko bachane ke liye...
Liechita ka badla lene ke liye...
Mai mar nahi sakta!
Aur saath hi...
Mai Usey marne nahi de sakta!

Usne dhyan rakha ki Woh mujhe seedha na
lage.

Usne mujhe chua tak nahi, par mere baazuon
ka union toot gaya.

Aur usne mera non-physical magic aur Mana
Zone bhi mita diya.
Magic ko cancel karna...

Agar Woh Sachme iska poori Takat se
istemal kare, toh...
Sabse Takatwaar.
Mai haar gaya.
M-.. Haan! Toh jaldi se chalte Hai!
Nahi.

L-Lekin Kyu?! Mai aur Liebe Devil Union
Usey kar paye the!

Bas ek second ke liye. Tumne abhi tak isme
maharat hasil nahi ki.
Aur tu yeh janta hai. Kya Mai galat Hu?

Woh sahi keh raha hai. Par hum yahan tak
pahunche Hai!

Agar tu Iss haal mein dushman ke ilaake
mein gaya bhi,
toh tera ant maut ke siva kuch nahi hoga.
Lekin Mai...
Apne Shadow Magic ka istemal karke...

Mai tera aur Black Bulls squad ke baaki
Members ka dhyan rakh raha tha.
Kya?

Bina Magic ke paida hua, aur shaitaan
Aa gaya
Aur ek zaalim kismat ne tujhe sataya.
Lekin...
Tu Humesha sahi tha.

Tune kaha tha: "Lekin iska matlab yeh nahi
ki sachai walon ko inaam milega."
Lekin...

Mai chahta Hu sachai walon ko inaam
mile.
Naib-e-Qaid Nahato...
Mai Gimodelo ko yahin chhodunga.
Kya?!

Hum poori koshish karenge taaki tu humse
jud sake.

Isliye jitna ho sake khud ko behtar
bana...
Phir aakar humse jud jaana!
Theek hai!
Mai mar Jaaunga agar woh waar mujhe laga!
Naato-san ek shaitaan Hai!

Hume khushi hui aapke sath kaam karke
Gimodelo!

Woh dono mujhe pakka maarne ki koshish kar
rahe Hai!
Chalo, ab chalte Hai!

Lagta hai sabhi yahin Hai. Kya tum sab
taiyar ho?

Crimson Lion Squad ke Qaid Fuegoleon
Vermillion
Asta kahan hai?
Aqua Deer Squad ke Qaid Rill Boismortier
Usey thoda aur samay lagega.

Green Mantis Squad ka Sekke Bronzazza

Aisa nahi hai ki Mai uspar Bharoosa kar
raha Hu!
Kya? Asta nahi aayega?

Koi baat nahi. Hum jald hi kuch bohot
mazedaar dekhenge!
Sally
Paltos
Radhes Spirito

kar Saku

Coral Peacocks Squad ki Qaida Dorothy
Unsworth

Jo maine Asta ke jism ka Study karke
banaye Hai!
Golden Dawn Squad ke Langris Vaude
Silver Eagles Squad ke Qaid Nozel Silva

Yeh libas... Suna hai isne banaye Hai.
Kya yeh surakshit Hai?
Makusa North

Sally thodi ajeeb hai, par woh Magical
hathyaron ke Research mein sabse behtar hai!
Ralph Niaflem
Fikar mat karo.

Makusa! Sirf Magical hathyaron ka naam
sunte hi beech mein mat aao!
Dekho Radhes!

Shayad tumhe yakeen na ho, par yeh libas
Magic ko chhupa sakte Hai!

Jaise Sally ne kaha, Asta ke Magic ko
khatam karne ka Study karne ke baad,
Humne aisi shaandar cheez banayi hai...
Bas chup raho!
Oho Bhagwaan.
M-M-... Mujhe...

Kyu mujhe shaitaan ke star ki paagalpan
waali mission mein hissa lena pad raha hai
In sab paagalon ke beech?!

Maine pichle 6 mahino mein apni poori
jaan laga di, par...!

Sekke! In qaido ko dikha do tum kya kar
sakte ho!

Kisi ne mujhe nahi bataya tha ki hum
seedhe jahannam ja rahe Hai!

Mujhe pata nahi
behtar hoga ki tum apni poori taakat laga
do.

Sachai walon ke liye apni jaan qurban kar
do.
Kya?!
Kya Asta waqt par pahunch paayega?
Woh aayega chahe kuch bhi ho jaye.

Isliye hum 3 samuhon mein batenge aur
ek saath Humla karke unhe mitayenge!
Castle ke bahar bhatkane ke bawajood,

shayad andhere ke apostle tumhara rasta
rokenge.
Ghuspithiye!

Jab aisa ho, koi ek bait bane aur hungama
kare.

Aur unhe Humesha ke liye khatam karne ke
liye,

hum trios ko girane ke liye sabse Jyada
bhejenge.
Yeh tumhara ant hai, andhere ke trios!
